fusions.name: Ledge Shove
fusions.desc: A head-butt that deals 14 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Scrabbling Kicks
fusions.desc: Kicks out in every direction, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Planted Paws
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds and your dodge chance by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Sure Perch
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
